To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
online teaching and learning is effective in teaching physiology to 1st year medical students during the COVID pandemic.
the online mode of learning is effective and feasible in teaching physiology to the undergraduate medical students and it may be continued as a part of teaching learning and assessment in future.
the online teaching program is a feasible, effective, and satisfactory mode of teaching physiology to undergraduate students.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the online teaching and learning experience of medical students in a pandemic situation.
the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on medical education in a developing country.
the impact of online medical teaching on the stress level of medical students and their performance during the COVID 19 pandemic.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the students have performed well in the online mode of teaching and learning and have accepted this mode as an alternative to the offline mode of learning.
online teaching can be used effectively as a tool for medical education and can be a part of future teaching learning and evaluation program.
the online teaching program is effective and feasible in the current situation of pandemic.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the students are able to learn the subject and also able to cope up with stress during this online learning.
the online teaching program is a feasible, cost-effective, and efficient tool for teaching physiology and may be considered as an important component of the medical curriculum.
online teaching and learning are effective and can be used as an adjunct to traditional teaching.
The main takeaway from our work is that
online teaching can be a viable alternative to traditional teaching and can be continued along with traditional mode of teaching.
online teaching can be effectively used as a supplement to the existing teaching and learning process.
online teaching can be effectively used in the future to complement the traditional teaching and learning process.
